items.name: hanji-system
items.title: hanji system
items.description: Provider, Theme, slot helpers, part factories, icon adapter, springs and base styles every hanji component uses.

items.name: artwork
items.title: Artwork
items.description: Generated cover art for anything without an image: 100 faces (ten palettes × ten compositions) chosen by hashing an id, printed on hanji’s paper fibres. Plus collage covers, glyph covers and a real image with art standing in.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person as a picture, or as their initials on a tint that stays theirs everywhere.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A count or a dot on top of something: unread messages, new releases, items waiting.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The verb on a screen: triggers an action.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: Small, tappable facts: a filter to turn on, a value that was picked, a suggested action.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard key, set in mono on a hairline, for shortcuts in menus, fields and help text.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: A styled anchor that goes somewhere, in running text or in chrome.

items.name: scrim
items.title: Scrim
items.description: A gradient that darkens imagery just enough for text to sit on it, in one colour fading by opacity.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A hairline between groups — hanji’s way of separating instead of boxing.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A still block in the shape of what is coming, so the page keeps its layout while it loads.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: An ink ring for work that takes a moment and has no measurable progress.

items.name: squircle
items.title: Squircle
items.description: A continuous-corner (squircle) surface — hanji’s corner, exact on every browser.

items.name: status
items.title: Status
items.description: A state in words — word, glyph and tint — with when it happened.

items.name: text
items.title: Text
items.description: Text set in one of hanji’s type roles, from the hero number down to the mono timecode.

items.name: autocomplete
items.title: Autocomplete
items.description: A text input that suggests as you type. The value is the text; suggestions only help.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid for picking a day or a range. No dependencies: local days, names from Intl.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A box you tick for a yes/no choice that takes effect when the form is saved.

items.name: checkbox-group
items.title: CheckboxGroup
items.description: Several related checkboxes sharing one value array, with an optional “Select all” parent.

items.name: choice-card
items.title: ChoiceCard
items.description: A radio group drawn as cards, each stating what choosing it will cost.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Type to filter a list and pick one value, or several shown as chips in the field.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: DatePicker
items.description: A field-like trigger that opens a Calendar in a popover, for a day or a range.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A labelled text input with its help line and its error, wired for validation and screen readers.

items.name: fieldset
items.title: Fieldset
items.description: Groups related fields under a legend; consecutive groups are divided by a hairline, never boxed.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: A form that validates its Fields together, takes server errors by field name, and sums them up after a failed submit.

items.name: number-field
items.title: NumberField
items.description: A number stepped with − and +, held to repeat, or typed — with changed digits rolling into place.

items.name: otp-field
items.title: OTPField
items.description: A one-time code entered one character per cell, pasted or typed.

items.name: password-field
items.title: PasswordField
items.description: A Field for passwords: a reveal toggle and an optional strength line that says what to do.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: RadioGroup
items.description: Exactly one of a few options, all visible at once.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: Choose one to five stars, or read an average as stars and a number.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: SegmentedControl
items.description: Two to five short, mutually exclusive options in one pill, with an indicator that slides to the choice.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Choose one value (or several) from a list that is too long, or too dynamic, for radios.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A value on a continuous scale where the feel matters more than the exact number.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off setting that applies the moment it is flipped.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed until pressed again: Shuffle, Bold, Mute.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: ToggleGroup
items.description: A row of Toggles in one frame, sharing a value array.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: AlertDialog
items.description: A confirm that must be answered: says what will happen to what, and offers at most two choices.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: An inline notice that stays on the page until it is resolved or dismissed.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A surface for one thing — an album, an episode, an article — usually a link to it.

items.name: coach-mark
items.title: CoachMark
items.description: A short product tour: a spotlight on a real control and a bubble that says what it does, one step at a time.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: ContextMenu
items.description: A Menu opened by right-click or long-press on an area, at the pointer.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A centred question or short task that stops the page until it is answered.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: A list of commands that opens from a button: actions, options and nested choices.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A row of menus (File · Edit · View) that behave as one, for desktop-style apps.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A small anchored surface for detail or a quick task that belongs to the thing that opened it.

items.name: preview-card
items.title: PreviewCard
items.description: A card that previews where a link goes when the pointer rests on it or it gets focus.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: ScrollArea
items.description: A native scroll container with a thin overlay scrollbar and edges that fade where content continues.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A surface that rises from an edge with options or detail, keeping the screen behind it in view. Swipe it away.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A brief, announced message about something that just happened, with at most one action.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label that names a control on hover or keyboard focus.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A stack of headings that each reveal their own section.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: Where this page sits in a hierarchy, with a way back up each level.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: One region the user can show or hide: “Show 6 more”, “Advanced options”.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: NavigationMenu
items.description: A site’s top navigation: links and triggers that open rich link panels in one shared, morphing surface.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Moves through numbered pages of a long list or table.

items.name: steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: Shows progress through a short ordered task: where you are, what’s done, what’s left.

items.name: tab-bar
items.title: TabBar
items.description: The mobile-web bottom bar: three to five top-level destinations, icon over label.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switches between views of the same subject without leaving the page.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: A group of controls that acts as one tab stop; arrow keys move inside it.

items.name: counter
items.title: Counter
items.description: A number whose changed digits roll into place, so a change is seen without re-reading the whole figure.

items.name: drag-list
items.title: DragList
items.description: A list you reorder by picking a row up: the handle lifts at once, a long press lifts from anywhere else, and every drag has a keyboard twin.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: EmptyState
items.description: What fills a region when there is nothing to show: a glyph, a title, one sentence and the way out.

items.name: list
items.title: List
items.description: Rows of 56px: artwork or an icon, a title and a line under it, and a value or chevron on the right.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: A single line too long for its box — a track title on a player — that rests, then travels so the whole of it can be read.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: A measurement within a known range, coloured by how good it is: storage, battery, signal, password strength.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: How far a task has got: a 4px track with a fill, and an optional label and value.

items.name: progress-ring
items.title: ProgressRing
items.description: Progress as a ring: a 40px status beside a row, or a 96px summary with the value inside.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: A number that matters: what it counts, the figure with its unit shrunk, how it compares in words, and the recent past as a line.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Rows of records compared across columns: hairlines, a sticky header, sortable columns, numbers right-aligned in tabular figures.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: A vertical sequence of steps with their times: what happened, what is happening, what is next, and what failed.

items.name: virtual-list
items.title: VirtualList
items.description: A long list that renders only the rows on screen: rows measure themselves, the reading position holds still as rows above change size, and scrollToIndex jumps anywhere.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: A file attached to a prompt or message: type glyph, name, size or error, remove, and an upload bar.

items.name: citation
items.title: Citation
items.description: An inline numbered source in a reply, with a preview card of the source on hover or focus.

items.name: code-block
items.title: CodeBlock
items.description: Code inside a reply or doc: syntax-highlighted from the theme (TS/JS/JSX, CSS, JSON, shell, HTML built in; Shiki or Prism pluggable), language and filename, copy (button, floating button or ⌘C), soft-wrap, line numbers. Snippet is the one-line, copy-first form for install commands and imports.

items.name: conversation
items.title: Conversation
items.description: A scrolling log of turns that keeps the newest reply in view while it streams — until the person scrolls up to read.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: One turn in a conversation: the person’s bubble, the assistant’s reply, or a system note.

items.name: message-actions
items.title: MessageActions
items.description: The small icon actions under an assistant reply: copy, regenerate, rate, more.

items.name: model-picker
items.title: ModelPicker
items.description: Chooses which model answers: the current one in a quiet trigger, each option with its provider, a capability line and tags.

items.name: prompt-input
items.title: PromptInput
items.description: The box a person types a prompt into: grows with the text, sends on Enter, becomes Stop while a reply streams.

items.name: reasoning
items.title: Reasoning
items.description: A model’s visible thinking: open while it works, folded to “Thought for 12 s” when the answer starts.

items.name: streaming-text
items.title: StreamingText
items.description: Renders a model’s streamed text with zero React work per token.

items.name: suggestions
items.title: Suggestions
items.description: A row of ready-made prompts the person can send with one tap.

items.name: tool-call
items.title: ToolCall
items.description: One tool an assistant called — name, status, arguments and result — collapsed to a line until opened.
